scenarios.name: Scenario A: Worker Disabled (Standard Remediation)
scenarios.prompt: The order processing service is failing. Investigate the issue, inspect the relevant logs and runbook, fix it if safe, verify that orders are processing again, and prepare an incident report.
scenarios.description: Background consumer worker was unexpectedly halted. Queue is backing up. Standard remediation (enable worker) resolves the issue, followed by verified queue processing.

scenarios.name: Scenario B: First Remediation Attempt Fails
scenarios.prompt: Investigate degraded order processing throughput. Attempt standard restart and adapt if the worker rejects the initial signal.
scenarios.description: Initial enable command encounters simulated intermittent lock. Agent observes state remained stopped, detects lock file in logs, performs cleanup and successful retry.

scenarios.name: Scenario C: Tool Timeout & State Re-check
scenarios.prompt: Investigate order worker health check latency and queue backlog under high load.
scenarios.description: A diagnostic probe simulates a network timeout. The agent does not blindly assume failure, but inspects current simulator state before considering retry.

scenarios.name: Scenario D: Conflicting Evidence Reconciliation
scenarios.prompt: Customer reported orders not completing, but superficial health check returns HTTP 200. Reconcile evidence and diagnose the root cause.
scenarios.description: HTTP /health returns 200 (shallow check), but queue depth is growing and worker logs report downstream database connection saturation. Agent gathers deeper evidence.

scenarios.name: Scenario E: Restricted Action Approval Gate
scenarios.prompt: Order processing worker is in a memory leak loop. Execute a full worker pool restart and configuration reload.
scenarios.description: Full worker restart is classified as RESTRICTED_REMEDIATION. Agent halts execution at AWAITING_APPROVAL until human operator confirms.

scenarios.name: Scenario F: Runtime Restart & Checkpoint Resumption
scenarios.prompt: Resume recovery of order processing pipeline from saved checkpoint after orchestrator restart.
scenarios.description: Orchestrator restores persisted task state, checks actual system state before resuming non-idempotent actions.

scenarios.name: Scenario G: Verification Failure Detection
scenarios.prompt: Verify resolution of order processing issue where downstream database is still read-only.
scenarios.description: Remediation succeeds superficially, but independent verification finds processing counters are not increasing. Agent flags VERIFICATION_FAILED instead of falsely completing.
